papers.title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents
papers.problem: Coding agents on long tasks get feedback that misses the real problem and nobody checks if it helped.
papers.fix: Opera tracks each correction until fixed and lifts task success by up to 15.0 percentage points on three coding tests.
papers.practicalUseCase: Better feedback loops make coding agents fix more bugs, so add follow-up checks after every correction you give one.
papers.limitation: Results come from three coding benchmarks and four policy models, so other tasks may differ.

papers.title: Skill Constellations: Tracing the Supply Chain of Agent Skills on GitHub
papers.problem: Developers copy agent skills between repositories, so nobody knows where a skill came from or who must fix it.
papers.fix: Auditing the 100 top-ranked source repositories prevents 14.9% of risky skill adoptions, against 0.5% for the most starred.
papers.practicalUseCase: Stars do not show which skills are safe, so check the few source repositories before you copy any skill.
papers.limitation: The study covers skills found in GitHub history, and its ranking predicts copying, not proven harm.

papers.title: The Lattice of Transition Laws
papers.problem: Teams cannot tell in advance which way of generating text or images in parallel steps will work best.
papers.fix: The data's shape sets the fewest safe steps, and most predicted rankings held on text, image, and video.
papers.practicalUseCase: You can pick a decoding plan before running it, so save compute by checking the data's structure first.
papers.limitation: The authors verified most predictions, not all, so some rankings did not hold.

papers.title: Behavioral Persistence and Incomplete Functional Transfer of Co-evolved Communication in Evolutionary Robotics
papers.problem: Robots that learned to signal each other in simulation may not keep that skill in the real world.
papers.fix: After three corrections, one robot reached the food in one of thirty tests and the other never did.
papers.practicalUseCase: Skills learned in simulation can break on real hardware, so test on real robots early and expect big losses.
papers.limitation: The test used two e-puck robots on one food task, so it shows partial transfer, not a general rule.

papers.title: Sustainability Committees and Environmental Initiatives: Insights from Dual Banking Systems in Emerging Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Banks set up sustainability committees, but nobody knew if Islamic and conventional banks gain the same environmental results.
papers.fix: Committees raise environmental scores, but at Islamic banks they lift only overall and resource scores, not green products.
papers.practicalUseCase: A committee may be mostly show at Islamic banks, so judge them by green products, not committees.
papers.limitation: Panel regressions show links, not cause, and cover banks in emerging markets only.

papers.title: Trends and Determinants of Sustainability Sukuk Issuance: Evidence from Global Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Sustainability sukuk are growing, but little is known about what drives how big each issue is.
papers.fix: Across 11,944 sukuk issues, stronger security, longer debt terms, and USD or Euro denomination give larger issues.
papers.practicalUseCase: Equity-based contracts raise bigger issues than sale-based ones, so issuers wanting size should pick equity-based structures.
papers.limitation: The data runs only to 2022 and shows links, not cause.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Strategies to Enhance Islamic Banks’ Competitiveness and Sustainable Development
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Islamic banks in Jordan lacked clear evidence on whether AI and big data help them compete.
papers.fix: AI use, big data skills, and data management practices all link to higher competitiveness and better sustainable development results.
papers.practicalUseCase: Banks should invest in AI and data systems, but staff digital skill alone did not improve sustainable development.
papers.limitation: The survey covered 214 managers in Jordan at one point in time, so it shows links, not cause.

papers.title: ICT, High-Tech Exports, and Institutions as Drivers of Bank Expansion Growth in a Dual Banking System
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Banks in dual systems lacked clear evidence on which national factors drive their growth.
papers.fix: Across 218 banks, ICT adoption drives growth most, and high-tech exports help only when paired with ICT.
papers.practicalUseCase: Digital tools matter more than exports alone, so banks and regulators should fund digital systems first.
papers.limitation: The study covers 12 countries from 2010 to 2023 and shows links, not cause.

papers.title: Determinants of Financial Inclusion in the OIC and OECD Countries: Are They Different?
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.institution: International Centre for Education in Islamic Finance
papers.problem: Muslim-majority countries have many excluded people, even though Islamic finance grew fast over the last decade.
papers.fix: In OIC countries, income, university education, institutions, and internet access drive financial inclusion, and OECD countries show a different pattern.
papers.practicalUseCase: OIC countries gain most from digital infrastructure and from empowering youth and women, so banks there should target those groups.
papers.limitation: The model covers 35 countries from 2005 to 2021 and shows links, not cause.
